title: Aureline M5 run-comparison-table component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the run-comparison-table family binds inside the frozen M5 experiment-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-experiment-component-matrix.schema.json). A run comparison table names along which axis it compares runs and whether two runs are actually comparable so a table never implies an apples-to-apples comparison without parity evidence and always discloses confounders. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
